== Hero Usage ==
* There are two criteria governing hero usage of this spell.
# Against single targets, heroes will only use Rodgort's if the foes health is below 25%.
# Against grouped foes, heroes will use Rodgort's so long as at least two enemies are within nearby range of each other.

== Notes ==
* This spell will not [[fail]] if your target dies mid-cast.


== Trivia ==
* Rodgort spelled backwards is [[w:Trogdor|Trogdor]], which is the name of a dragon from one of the [[w:Homestar Runner|Homestar Runner]] cartoons.
** There is another skill with the same name reference, [[Mark of Rodgort]].
* This skill has the same animation as when a circle is picked in the [[Nine Rings]] and is a bigger version of [[Incendiary Arrows]] and [[Incendiary Bonds]].
